scope: Six discovery queries: two web lead searches and four first-page GitHub code queries. Three purposive pinned source cases; no execution or full repository audit.

anonymous_source_cases.observed: A PermissionRequest prompt directs denial of sensitive-path and risky-command requests. Inspected JSON has no shell credential-collection or transmission command.
anonymous_source_cases.limit: One prompt path; no whole-package safety verdict.

anonymous_source_cases.observed: A PreToolUse hook invokes a local Python blocker. It compares invocation paths and commands with credential patterns and rejects matches. Inspected imports and source show no file-content collection or network transmission.
anonymous_source_cases.limit: Source tracing only; no hook invocation.

anonymous_source_cases.observed: A SessionStart hook conditionally installs a dependency after an import check. The README discloses automatic installation.
anonymous_source_cases.limit: Minimum-version dependency remains mutable; registry integrity, every dependency and later releases were not audited.

primary_mechanism_context.supports: Upstream workspace-defined Claude hook approval vulnerability.
primary_mechanism_context.limit: Not evidence these candidates are malicious or that a campaign exploited this issue.

primary_mechanism_context.supports: Upstream indirect prompt injection with command allowlist bypass.

separate_known_mirror_availability_check.observed_results: Live HEAD API and selected web requests returned 404; another selected path returned a stale cached error shell without pinned Markdown.
separate_known_mirror_availability_check.limits: Unavailable source does not prove deletion or takedown. Dated prior reporting remains attributed prior work, not present availability.

limits: Search totals and returned rows are not malicious-package counts.
The three inspected paths did not establish a malicious publisher; this selected set cannot estimate prevalence or certify ecosystem safety.
No dependency installation, target execution, payload acquisition, service invocation or outreach in this pass.
Unconfirmed identities and their source identifiers are withheld.
publication_status: Prepared for owner review; not published.
